# Stellaris Save Game Locations

Each .sav file is a ZIP archive containing two text files: gamestate and meta. They include all the game state data and the meta-information that is shown on the load game screen.

Do not use WinRAR as it messes compressed lines.

## Steam Version

OS | Save Type | Location
---|-----------|---------
Windows | Auto saves (incl. Ironman) | \Steam\userdata\%STEAMUSERID%\281990\remote\save games\$EMPIRENAME+ID\
Windows | Custom saves | %USERPROFILE%\Documents\Paradox Interactive\Stellaris\save games\$EMPIRENAME+ID\
macOS | Saves | $HOME/Documents/Paradox Interactive/Stellaris/save games/$EMPIRENAME+ID
Linux (older versions) | Saves | $HOME/.local/share/Paradox Interactive/Stellaris/save games/$EMPIRENAME+ID
Linux (newer versions) | Saves | $STEAMFOLDER/userdata/$STEAMID/281990/remote/save games/$EMPIRENAME+ID
macOS | Cloud Saves |  ~/Library/Application Support/Steam/userdata/<YOUR STEAM ID>/281990/remote/save games/

## Paradox Launcher Version

OS | Location
---|-----------
Windows | %USERPROFILE%\Documents\Paradox Interactive\Stellaris Plaza\save games\$EMPIRENAME+ID\
macOS | $HOME/.local/share/Paradox Interactive/Stellaris/save games/$EMPIRENAME+ID (Maybe?)
Linux | $HOME/.local/share/Paradox Interactive/Stellaris Plaza/save games/$EMPIRENAME+ID

## GamePass Launcher Version

OS | Location
---|-----------
Windows | %USERPROFILE%\Documents\Paradox Interactive\Stellaris GamePass\save games\$EMPIRENAME+ID\
